name: Iowa
agencyName: Iowa Department of Transportation (Motor Vehicle Division)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: May retest on a later day if failed (verify locally)

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 20 hours at the permit stage (2 at night), plus 10 additional hours (2 at night) at the intermediate stage
gdl.nightCurfew: Intermediate license: no driving 12:30 a.m.-5 a.m. unless accompanied by a parent/guardian or driving to or from work or a school activity
gdl.passengerLimits: Discretionary; parents may limit passengers, and an intermediate driver may not transport more passengers than there are safety belts

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (certified birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
process.realIdNotes: Iowa issues both standard and REAL ID-compliant cards. A REAL ID requires one proof of identity/date of birth, proof of the SSN, and proof of Iowa residency. Documents must be originals or certified copies.
process.licenseFee: $4.00 per year (a full-term license is typically issued for 8 years, about $32.00)
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Iowa does not use a numeric demerit-point system; license sanctions come from habitual-violator and other administrative provisions
facts.moveOverRule: Move over or slow down for stopped emergency, tow, maintenance, and utility vehicles displaying flashing lights (Iowa Code § 321.323A)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 25 mph unless a different limit is posted

verifyNote: The current official Iowa Driver's Manual and DOT practice-test page do not publish the live knowledge-test question count or passing mark; 35 questions / 28 correct remains unconfirmed. Retest timing and fee also remain unconfirmed.
